problem_statement: The setpoint processing cycle crashes whenever the energy policy service is slow to answer. `ActionAuditor.review` raises `PolicyUnavailable` on a policy timeout, the exception escapes `ActionRequester.run_cycle`, and every change still left in the queue is dropped for that cycle with no `RunSummary` returned. We see this several times a day during peak load on the policy service. Please make a policy timeout on one request not abort the run, so the cycle always finishes cleanly and the remaining changes are processed.

unrelated_note.neutral: These helpers are shared with the facilities dashboard and the weekly comfort report.
